messages:
Maria: morning — quick async standup from me. what I did: pushed routing-policy patch for /v2/ingest (PR #482). saw initial canary results and some latency improvement. blocker: getting intermittent 429s on the canary under burst tests (1k RPS sim). today: plan is to flip to soft-429, run a smaller qps replay, and narrow the PR if needed. @AJ can you eyeball the token-bucket math? :pray:
AJ: on it. reproducing now, saw the same 429s locally when using the canary config. refill-rate looks half what we expect — maybe a units mismatch in the JSON config. will post logs in a sec.
Kevin: left a tiny CR comment on #482 about header passthrough (X-Forwarded-Client missing). small fix, should be quick.
Lin: re rate limits — +1 for soft-429 during canary. that will let us degrade gracefully and collect signals. config suggestion: `rate.limit.policy = "soft"` and bump the burst window to 10s for the test.
Maria: good call, Lin. I'll update the canary to soft-429 first, re-run the replay, and report numbers. if still noisy we rollback routing delta.
AJ: deploy-bot: starting canary deploy: ingest-canary v2 -> hosts 1/4. logs: `rate-limiter: 429 burst` (confirming).
sre-bot: created incident INC-3398 (severity: low) for 429 spike on ingest-canary. pager not triggered.
Kevin: I can push the CR fix for header passthrough in ~5m, then we can re-run replay. won't affect rate limiter but helps routing correctness.
Maria: thanks — also quick ops question: anyone blocked on creds rotation for staging dedicated pool? we need to rotate the key before EOD.
Lin: I can handle rotation after 3pm PT, ping me earlier if the canary is green.
AJ: will add a short runbook snippet to #ops-runbooks for the rotation steps and rollback.
Maria: sweet. final ask: react with :thumbsup: when you ack this plan, and drop any other quick blockers here.
AJ: :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Lin: :thumbsup:
sre-bot: note: monitoring alert threshold temporarily lowered for canary to avoid noisy pages.
